description: TangoFlux (515M-parameter FluxTransformer with a FLAN-T5-large text encoder and a stereo 44.1 kHz Oobleck VAE, flow matching, trained with CLAP-Ranked Preference Optimization): text prompt to up to 30 seconds of 44.1 kHz stereo audio. Stability AI Community License (non-commercial and research use; free below USD 1M annual revenue); the training data includes WavCaps, which is academic-use only. The FLAN-T5-large encoder is catalogued separately.
